summary: WiseKey International Holding AG (filer), via its subsidiary WISeSat.Space Corp., is party to a definitive Business Combination Agreement dated November 9, 2025 with SPAC Columbus Acquisition Corp (Nasdaq: COLA). A Form F-4 registration statement for the proposed business combination was filed on June 23, 2026, under which WISeSat and CAC will become subsidiaries of Pubco, with combined shares expected to trade on Nasdaq under ticker SAIQ. No deal terms (price, premium, break fee) or board recommendations/advisors are disclosed. Completion requires SEC effectiveness, CAC shareholder approval, and Nasdaq listing approval. Watch for SEC review and shareholder vote timelines.
